unresolved-context.label: 원본 문맥 참조
unresolved-context.note: Source-context evidence is retained for engine diagnostics; use productRules for the current processing scope.

variable-hit-count.label: 가변 연속기 타격 횟수
variable-hit-count.bounds: Use the move-specific multihit range; ability/item exceptions also need validation.
variable-hit-count.note: Select an integer within the move-specific range; fixed-count and Skill Link restrictions apply.

fixed-hit-count.label: 고정 연속기
fixed-hit-count.note: Keep per-hit mechanics; a fixed hit count is not the number of move uses.

fainted-allies.label: 쓰러진 아군 수
fainted-allies.note: Product input is 0–5 for both moves/abilities; the source Last Respects mechanic cap remains 100.

status-trigger.label: 상태이상 선택
status-trigger.note: One status per Pokemon. A selected status-trigger ability assigns its required/default status; users may change or clear it. No status damage/healing or action-failure probability.

ability-activation.label: 특성 발동 토글
ability-activation.note: Default ON for the agreed activation abilities; Analytic defaults OFF. Unburden disables item input. See per-ability product rules.

low-hp-activation.label: HP 조건 특성 발동 토글
low-hp-activation.note: Default ON on ability selection; force only the activation effect while preserving actual initial HP at 100%.

final-ranks.label: 랭크 변화는 최종 랭크에 포함
final-ranks.note: Do not reapply entry/event rank changes on top of the supplied final ranks. Preserve unrelated effects of the ability.

field-setting.label: 날씨·지형 생성 효과
field-setting.note: Field-setting abilities are not selected; use the opponent-local shared field inputs without simulating entry/hit events.

gender-condition.label: 투쟁심 상대 관계
gender-condition.note: Manual same/different toggle; no gender inputs or automatic neutral-gender override. Leave ability blank for no modifier.

hits-taken.label: 공격받은 누적 횟수
hits-taken.note: Six hits already reaches the power cap.

stockpile-count.label: 비축 횟수
stockpile-count.note: Zero is unusable. One-use result only; final ranks are entered separately.

party-composition.label: 아군별 참여 조건·종족값
party-composition.note: Beat Up is excluded from the calculation selector.

turn-history.label: 현재 턴·이전 행동의 조건
turn-history.note: Per-move product rules distinguish default-OFF power toggles, assumed success and single-use results. No general battle-history input.

incoming-damage.label: 직전에 받은 대미지와 공격 종류
incoming-damage.note: Derive incoming damage from the linked opponent build and move. Prompt for a missing move; do not require defense comparison. Reflection results are single-use only.

random-power.label: 기술 자체의 위력 분기
random-power.note: Choose the strengthened branch manually and keep it on repeated uses; do not aggregate its activation probability.

transformation.label: 변신·폼 변화
transformation.note: Keep selected calculation forms fixed. Protean/Libero use a default-ON move-type toggle; Disguise has an intact toggle. Transform/Imposter are excluded.

repeat-state-change.label: 반복 사용 중 상태 변화
repeat-state-change.note: Apply supported HP, item, screen/terrain and guaranteed-rank changes at their actual timing. Rank changes default ON. Exclude probabilistic rank/status changes, ability changes, item transfers and berry-eating effects; respect single-use limits.

repeated-use-power.label: 연속 사용 위력 변화
repeated-use-power.note: Track successive uses internally. Only implement for moves actually available in Champions.

delegated-move.label: 다른 기술을 호출
delegated-move.note: Copycat/Sleep Talk are excluded; choose the actual damaging move.

hp-dependent.label: 현재 HP 의존
hp-dependent.note: Start at full HP and update remaining HP per outcome. Super Fang/Pain Split/Endeavor are excluded; Final Gambit is single-use only.

status-move.label: 변화기
status-move.note: Keep in the full learnset. Exclusion from the damage selector is separate from game availability.

secondary-effects.label: 확률 부가효과
secondary-effects.note: Keep deterministic first-hit damage modifiers; do not combine secondary-effect chances with KO damage randomness.

residual-effects.label: 회복·턴 종료·반동 효과
residual-effects.note: This tag does not discard other damage/stat effects of the same ability or move.

critical-effects.label: 급소 관련 효과
critical-effects.note: No user critical toggle or probability aggregation; preserve intrinsic move mechanics supplied by the engine.

ally-only.label: 아군을 요구하는 효과
ally-only.note: Apply only to strictly ally-only effects, not all hooks whose name contains Ally.

custom-damage.label: 일반 위력식이 아닌 대미지
custom-damage.note: Native fixed-damage moves use engine data; linked reflection is single-use. OHKO moves and the three HP-manipulation exclusions are not selectable.

common.opponentStateScope: Local to one opponent; shared by its attack, defense and speed comparisons.
common.fieldScope: Per opponent; shared by its comparisons.
common.abilitySelection: Only effects relevant to supported direct damage or Speed; field-setting abilities use field inputs instead.
common.status: One selected status per Pokemon; preserve it during repeated KO calculation.
common.berries: One generic resist-berry option; no healing/stat-raising berries or separate stolen-berry eating effects.
common.consumption: Resist berries affect one qualifying hit; Normal Gem affects the whole first qualifying use; White Herb restores negative ranks once.
common.hpAndProtection: Update remaining HP and supported protection/consumption state after each hit, preserving outcome probabilities.

rules.processing: Integer within each move range; fixed-count/Skill Link conditions constrain it; reuse the selected count per use, without accuracy aggregation.
Use the faint count captured at entry, rather than reapplying an entry event.
Zero is unusable; starting final Defense/Special Defense ranks are separate and not boosted again.

rules.scope: Own-history conditions are Pokemon state; target-relative conditions are opponent-local.
rules.processing: Keep the selected power branch for every use; do not aggregate its activation probability.
Manual activation; do not infer from Speed. Keep the selected state on repeated uses.
Assume the move success prerequisites; no history or failure toggle.
Calculate incoming damage using the linked opponent build and move, then reflect it. Prompt when that move is missing; do not require a defense-comparison checkbox or simulate exchanged attacks.
Show one-use damage, rolls and OHKO probability only.
Do not block the one-use calculation for missing terrain; retain other field modifiers.
Use item-dependent power and validate throwability; no after-hit item effects or item reacquisition.
Derive activation from the same selected status used by abilities and Speed.
Derive activation from the target Pokemon status; poison-specific moves require poison/toxic poison.
Respect the actual before/after-hit timing and caps. OFF freezes supplied initial final ranks. Exclude probabilistic changes. Clear Smog resets only after its first successful damage calculation.
Apply the guaranteed pre-attack Special Attack increase at its original timing, including the first attack; do not double-count it as an entry boost.
Remove supported screens/terrain at the move-specific timing; recalculate affected later damage.
Apply the eligible first-use power bonus; remove the item after the hit and recalculate later damage, respecting removal restrictions.
Calculate ordinary damage without transferring held items.
Only the supported resist-berry reduction/consumption applies; no separate stolen-berry eating effects.
Keep ordinary move damage; do not change groundedness after hitting.
Keep direct damage and the selected status; do not apply status changes, PP changes or turn/action locks.
Selecting the ability sets its default status; allow explicit changes/clearing. No status damage or healing.
Keep the chosen activation during repeated uses; OFF retains passive effects. Low-HP toggles do not change actual HP. Stakeout is opponent-local.
Manual activation; do not infer from Speed.
Disable item input and calculate without a held item.
Same/different relation selects the modifier; do not request genders. Leave the ability blank for a neutral comparison.
ON uses the selected move type as current Pokemon type for attack/defense; OFF uses original types. Prompt for a missing move.
Select the calculation form directly and keep it during repeated KO; no turn/switch history.
Absorb the first qualifying hit, apply the break HP loss, then process remaining hits with broken Disguise; preserve ability-bypass rules.
Use the current HP for supported protection; update HP between hits. Sturdy survival affects KO, not the raw move damage rolls.
Select the current field directly; do not simulate field-setting events.

note: Product inputs and processing are planned, not implemented. mechanicInputIds/mechanicReviewRuleIds preserve the diagnostic audit scope; requiredInputIds/productRuleIds describe current product decisions.
